interface.title: LAFF Viewer (Lightcurve and Flare Fitter results browser)
interface.field: High-energy astrophysics: gamma-ray bursts observed by Swift (XRT X-ray and BAT gamma-ray instruments)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting results: browsing a fitted catalogue of light curves and the population statistics derived from them
interface.what_it_is_for: Look up any Swift GRB to see its fitted XRT and BAT light curves with afterglow, flare and pulse model parts and their parameter tables, or scatter-plot fitted and derived parameters across all afterglows, flares and pulses, highlight named bursts, and click a point to open that burst.

data.note: One bundled results dataset, '05/2025 (laff v1.0.0)', is the only choice in the sidebar dropdown (screens/039.webp). The About page says it holds 1273 X-ray afterglows, 1019 X-ray flares and 3994 gamma-ray pulses (screens/036.webp). On first load the Burst Viewer showed a StreamlitDuplicateElementKey error and two 'Select dataset' boxes (screens/002.webp). Picking a burst cleared the error and the page worked normally after that (screens/004.webp, screens/018.webp).
